cohort: The study included female patients aged 18-44 from a US collaborative healthcare network, comparing a cohort of 4347 patients with Marfan syndrome to a control cohort of 16,424,990 patients without Marfan or Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.
finding: Patients with Marfan syndrome were at an increased risk for numerous gynecologic disorders and obstetric complications, including pelvic and perineal pain, dysmenorrhea, endometriosis, urinary incontinence, female genital prolapse, fertility testing, gestational hypertension, and pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Patients with Marfan syndrome had an increased risk for cesarean delivery.
